description: Creates or updates messaging broadcasts, matched by ItemId. A new broadcast is always a draft, and a broadcast that is queued or sent is left as it is, so a recipe never sends a message.

items.description: A message to send to many recipients from one address.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Channel.description: The channel the broadcast is sent on, such as 'sms'.

ServiceAddress.description: The address the broadcast is sent from, such as the business phone number.

Recipients.description: The addresses the message goes to.

OwnerAgentId.description: The user id of the agent who owns the replies.

Broadcasts.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.
